in_marathi.name: Pavithraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pavithraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Pavithraj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pavithra' which means 'pure' and 'Raj' which means 'king'. This name signifies the one who is the ruler of the pure universe. It is a powerful and spiritual name in Hindu tradition.

vedic_reference.note: The name Pavithraj is a combination of two Sanskrit words, Pavitra and Raja. Pavitra means pure, sacred and holy, while Raja means king or ruler. This name is not directly referenced in any Vedic text, but it embodies the qualities of purity and leadership found in various Hindu deities and spiritual teachings.
